summary: OSpec 1.9.4 keeps every progress checklist aligned with what actually happened: proposal acceptance criteria now gate archiving in both workflows, verify-tagged acceptance items tick automatically, and the Goal review.md becomes a derived summary of the final review instead of an untouched template.
new: Goal acceptance criteria tagged `[verify:<id>]` in proposal.md are auto-ticked by `ospec execute sync` once matching `ospec execute verify ... --satisfies <id>` evidence passes.

Goal review.md is now a derived summary that `ospec execute sync` rewrites from the final review: decision, per-task review decisions, and a fact-based checklist with a `review_source` provenance marker.
improved: Archiving now blocks in both the classic change and Goal workflows while proposal.md still has unchecked acceptance items, so acceptance criteria can no longer be silently left behind.
Goal archiving blocks until review.md is aligned with the approved final review, so an untouched scaffold template can no longer be archived as the change review.
docs: Protocol documents, project conventions, and the packaged skills describe the progress-tracking contract in all four languages, including the rule that unfinished items must never be ticked and derived documents must never be edited by hand.
